name: Johnson & Johnson
notes: Revenue = 'Sales to customers'. J&J reports no operating income line in any year, so operatingIncome is derived for all years (quality estimated) from the statement of earnings as sales less cost of products sold, selling/marketing/administrative expenses, research and development, in-process R&D and restructuring. Interest income, interest expense and 'Other (income) expense, net' are excluded: other holds litigation charges (talc), divestiture and investment gains and pension items, which swing from 7.2bn income (2025) to 6.6bn expense (2023). Each year as first reported in that year's 10-K (FY2000-2009 from the restated FY2009 Exhibit 13 ten-year table, so they match revenue). FY ends Sunday closest to Dec 31 (FY2000-2006 period-end dates derived from that rule). FY2022 includes Consumer Health; FY2023 onward excludes Kenvue (restated FY2022 revenue 79,990). FY2015 is a 53-week year. From 2018 non-service pension cost moved out of operating costs (ASU 2017-07), so 2018 on is not strictly comparable with earlier years.
